scenario.title: UPS battery replacement with eligibility, scope correction, and withdrawal recovery
scenario.summary: The real Air Force requirement is for 80 UPS batteries with installation equipment, 60-day ARO, and a total small-business set-aside. The best complete eligible supplier withdraws; the remaining eligible supplier must correct an installation-scope omission before award.

realism.notes: The 80-unit quantity, installation-equipment scope, 60-day ARO, and total small-business set-aside are real public facts. Supplier behavior and prices are synthetic.

calibration_sources.title: FAR 15.306 Exchanges with offerors after receipt of proposals
calibration_sources.role: Process-pattern reference for clarification/discussion events; not governing law for non-U.S. episodes.

calibration_sources.title: FAR 15.206 Amending the solicitation
calibration_sources.role: Process-pattern reference for buyer requirement changes and solicitation amendments.

calibration_sources.title: UNDP How we buy
calibration_sources.role: Process-pattern reference for evaluating quotations on compliance, price, delivery, and other factors.

objective.description: Reach an award-ready procurement decision without violating the real starting constraints or scenario facts revealed during the episode.

suppliers.notes: Synthetic supplier used only inside this episode.
Cheaper but ineligible under the real set-aside.
Initial offer omits required installation equipment.

events.observation: Supplier A quotes USD 160,000 for 80 batteries with installation equipment and 55-day delivery.
Supplier B quotes USD 140,000 for 80 batteries with installation equipment and 50-day delivery but is not small-business eligible.
Supplier C quotes USD 145,000 for 80 batteries with 58-day delivery but excludes the installation equipment.
Supplier A withdraws its quotation before award.
Supplier C asks whether the installation equipment must be included in its scope.

details.question: Must installation equipment be included with the 80 UPS batteries?

events.observation: After confirmation, Supplier C revises to USD 150,000 for 80 batteries including installation equipment, with 58-day delivery.

hard_constraints.description: Awarded supplier must satisfy the real total small-business set-aside.
Award must cover the real quantity of 80 batteries.
Delivery must satisfy the real 60-day ARO requirement.
Awarded scope must include the installation equipment stated in the real requirement.
A withdrawn supplier cannot receive award.
Only the latest revealed revision for a supplier may support award.

acceptable_terminal_outcomes.rationale: After Supplier A withdraws, Supplier C's corrected offer is the remaining eligible offer meeting quantity, installation scope, and 60-day delivery.

failure_conditions: Awarding the cheaper ineligible Supplier B.
Awarding Supplier C's original scope without installation equipment.

economic_objective.description: Among remaining eligible feasible active offers, prefer the lowest total awarded price.
